🤖 Talos triage · confidence: medium

Talos can make mistakes. Please check important information.

Verdict
No defect established yet — the fiscal period this work item covers is computed correctly and nothing in this client's configuration explains an empty result, so the run record for that period is what settles it.

What we checked

  • The client's fiscal calendar puts the just-closed monthly period at 24 Aug – 27 Sep 2026 (a valid five-week window, and the last period of their fiscal year), so the reporting window itself is neither empty nor mis-dated.

  • This client is configured to wait 2 days and 7 hours after a fiscal period closes before results for it are produced — for a period ending 27 Sep that threshold passed on 30 Sep, i.e. after the 29 Sep check; and when the data-readiness check defers a period the run is simply marked pending with no error shown, so "0 results" does not by itself distinguish "ran and found nothing" from "not produced yet".

Next

  • Re-check the work item today now that the waiting window for that period has passed, and note whether records have appeared.

  • Pull the run record for this work item for 24 Aug – 27 Sep 2026 and compare it against the other monthly work items for the same period — that separates "held back / not produced" from "produced and matched nothing".

Issue: Work item returned 0 results for fiscal period 24 Aug–27 Sep 2026. Non-zero in prior 2 periods.

Context: This as likely a false alarm: this client is configured to wait 2 days 7 hours after fiscal period close before producing results for that period. If the period closes end-of-day 27 Sep, the wait threshold clears roughly 30 Sep ~07:00, consistent with the customer's "0 results" observation coming from a run "yesterday" (9/29), before the window cleared. The exact wait-window value and fiscal-close timestamp should be confirmed against the actual client config rather than assumed.

Separately, this is a Discounts field, not loyalty/MemberID. Given how much catalog desync this same client has already had from that migration, "no defect found" shouldn't be treated as fully settled without checking whether any Discounts-related field was also remapped during the cutover.

Steps to review/replicate:

  1. Re-check the work item now, the wait window has already passed as of this afternoon.

  2. Pull the run record for 24 Aug–27 Sep 2026 for this work item; confirm completed / errored / held-back status.

  3. Compare against other monthly work items for the same client/period to distinguish "held back" from "ran and found nothing."

  4. If still zero, check whether any Discounts/serve-ware field for c166_sbx was touched by the 8/27 SnowTime cutover

Next steps: If records are now present, this is a readiness-delay non-issue. Reply to customer explaining the wait window and close. If still empty after confirming the window has passed, escalate for real investigation rather than assuming it's timing-related.

Items on 30 Sep

Finding. The 0 for 24 Aug to 27 Sep is the real result of the rule. No partner met all three thresholds in that period.

Fiscal period

Trigger search rows, 30 Sep

Partners meeting 2 transactions, 2 dates and $30

24 Aug to 27 Sep

How I checked. I took the discount codes from the transactions behind August work items 156176 and 156175: Partner Discount code 6, controllable codes 3 and 4, ProductHierarchy1 085. I rebuilt the rule on ARDM_PRODUCTION.C166_SBX with those values. P2 matches the live search exactly. P1 is one short because the rebuild leaves out the second product hierarchy list, which I could not read.

Ruled out so far: the reference_Employee join, the partner fields on ardm_header, the item and product joins, and a change in discount codes. All complete before and after 27 Aug.

Conclusion. No defect found for this definition. The period had partner activity on serveware, and none of it reached the thresholds.

Related: https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/RCS-29205 and https://trebuco.atlassian.net/browse/RCS-29207

Hello @Manish Sethia ,

Thank you for your patience while I looked into the serve ware work item.

I reviewed the fiscal period from 24 August to 27 September against the criteria this work item uses. Partners did receive controllable discounts on serve ware in that period. From what I can see, none of them reached all three thresholds together: at least two transactions, on at least two different dates, adding up to at least $30 in controllable discounts.

That looks to be why the run came back empty. The same check returns the records you saw for July and August.

I have not found anything wrong with how the work item ran for that period. If it would help, I can walk you through the partners who came closest, or keep this ticket open through the next run so you can compare.

Thanks again for flagging it, and just let me know which you prefer.

Kind regards, Juan Martinez Appriss Retail Support
